question: How is this abode established within the ongoing course of the world?
premises: Support of all knowledge grounds worldly functioning.
It is established in the course of the world.
inference: As the support of all knowledge, it is established in the course of the world.
uncertainties: Lokayātrā may refer to worldly conduct, cosmic process, or both.
plain_english: As the support of all knowledge, it is established in the course of the world.
